helpdesk-ticket.description: To create a procedure to block check-in process through Mobility PX and add notification/message to refer to Registration Counter. In EM-HIS, there are scenarios where users are required to modify or assign billing from a previous encounter before proceeding with the current visit. However, when patients use Mobility PX for self-check-in, this necessary billing adjustment step is bypassed.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: ML-MMOH-CRF-2237 - BL-PHA Procedure to Block Check-in Process
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
To create a procedure to block check-in process through Mobility PX and add notification/message to refer to Registration Counter. 
In EM-HIS, there are scenarios where users are required to modify or assign billing from a previous encounter before proceeding with the current visit. However, when patients use Mobility PX for self-check-in, this necessary billing adjustment step is bypassed.

helpdesk-ticket.description: Patient Drug Profile Serdang testing environment has been updated to the DEC25 MR. We have observed some changes in the Patient Drug Profile queries. There appears an alignment /overlapping issue when comparing the Sept 2024 MR Vs Dec 2025 MR for the Patient Drug Profile. This issue was previously raised, and we have included the earlier email communication for your reference. It had already been resolved at that time. FYI, ML-MMOH-SCF-1919 was raised and fix delivered in SPD-12.14.1.19.0.089 (Mar 2022). Our users are seriously concerned about this matter and are worried that it may lead to clinical risks. We would appreciate it if you could provide a strong justification for these changes so that we can share it with them. Our concern now is why this issue has reoccurred, and which region requested these changes. Based on the Build Highlight Report 12.17.4 – Serdang, there is no indication of any changes to the Drug Profile. We would appreciate your clarification on this matter.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: PH Queries - To remove vertical scrolling between Generic Name and Status column.
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Patient Drug Profile
 
Serdang testing environment has been updated to the DEC25 MR.
We have observed some changes in the Patient Drug Profile queries. 
There appears an alignment /overlapping issue when comparing the Sept 2024 MR Vs Dec 2025 MR for the Patient Drug Profile. 
 
This issue was previously raised, and we have included the earlier email communication for your reference. It had already been resolved at that time. FYI, ML-MMOH-SCF-1919 was raised and fix delivered in SPD-12.14.1.19.0.089 (Mar 2022).

Our users are seriously concerned about this matter and are worried that it may lead to clinical risks. We would appreciate it if you could provide a strong justification for these changes so that we can share it with them.
 
Our concern now is why this issue has reoccurred, and which region requested these changes. Based on the Build Highlight Report 12.17.4 – Serdang, there is no indication of any changes to the Drug Profile.
We would appreciate your clarification on this matter.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi MOHD ASYRAF MD SAID, ​ The lab slowness issue could be related to the ordering query, which is causing spikes in DB server resource usage. We have an action plan in place to identify the root cause of the ordering query issue with the support of the Level 3 team. In the meantime, we will keep this ticket on hold until the ordering SQL issue (SCF-3469) is resolved. Regards, AdeaHub Support
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi MOHD ASYRAF MD SAID,

​
The lab slowness issue could be related to the ordering query, which is causing spikes in DB server resource usage.
We have an action plan in place to identify the root cause of the ordering query issue with the support of the Level 3 team. In the meantime, we will keep this ticket on hold until the ordering SQL issue (SCF-3469) is resolved.


Regards,
AdeaHub Support

helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Assalamualaikum Tuan, 

Untuk makluman, BTM dijadualkan untuk memberi taklimat kepada Pegawai Perubatan Siswazah (HO) pada 29 April 2026. Sebagai sebahagian daripada latihan, para pegawai berkenaan perlu mengakses portal E-Learning HIS 12.x bagi tujuan pembelajaran kendiri.

2.    Oleh itu, mohon bantuan pihak tuan untuk menyediakan dan mengaktifkan akaun berdasarkan senarai yang dilampirkan bagi tempoh 14 hari (29 April – 12 Mei 2026).

3.    Pihak kami juga memohon agar laporan penggunaan dan status penyelesaian diserahkan kepada BTM selepas tamat tempoh tersebut bagi tujuan pemantauan.
Perhatian dan kerjasama pihak Tuan berhubung perkara di atas amat dihargai.

Sekian, terima kasih.

helpdesk-ticket.description: Hello AdeaHub Team, We would like to request an urgent modification to the Carboplatin calculation feature within the system. The following changes are required in the current calculation logic: Minimum creatinine value should be configurable, currently required as 0.8 The absolute Carboplatin dose cap should be configurable for each AUC level The system must allow users to modify the AUC value as clinically required At present, the current logic is limiting clinical workflow and does not support the required flexibility for protocol-based chemotherapy prescribing. Kindly investigate this as a Change Request (CR) and advise on the expected timeline for implementation. Please refer to the attached screenshots / clinical requirements if needed. Your prompt support on this high-priority request would be greatly appreciated.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Urgent CR Request: Modification Required in Carboplatin Calculation Logic (Minimum Creatinine, Dose Cap, and Editable AUC)
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hello AdeaHub Team,
We would like to request an urgent modification to the Carboplatin calculation feature within the system.
The following changes are required in the current calculation logic:
  • Minimum creatinine value should be configurable, currently required as 0.8
  • The absolute Carboplatin dose cap should be configurable for each AUC level
  • The system must allow users to modify the AUC value as clinically required
At present, the current logic is limiting clinical workflow and does not support the required flexibility for protocol-based chemotherapy prescribing.
Kindly investigate this as a Change Request (CR) and advise on the expected timeline for implementation.
Please refer to the attached screenshots / clinical requirements if needed.
Your prompt support on this high-priority request would be greatly appreciated.

helpdesk-note.body: Kindly refer to the reply below from Dr. Abdullah Alrajhi regarding the carboplatin dose capping. ( Just to align on carboplatin dosing: Please cap the creatinine clearance at 125 mL/min when calculating doses. All AUC-based dosing should be derived using this capped value, regardless of the patient’s actual calculated creatinine clearance if it exceeds 125. Using this approach, the approximate total doses would be: AUC 4 → ~600 mg AUC 5 → ~750 mg AUC 6 → ~900 mg AUC 7 → ~1050 mg These are all calculated based on a creatinine clearance capped at 125 mL/min, and this principle should be consistently applied across all dosing.)
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Kindly refer to the reply below from Dr. Abdullah Alrajhi regarding the carboplatin dose capping.
(
Just to align on carboplatin dosing:
Please cap the creatinine clearance at 125 mL/min when calculating doses. All AUC-based dosing should be derived using this capped value, regardless of the patient’s actual calculated creatinine clearance if it exceeds 125.
Using this approach, the approximate total doses would be:
  • AUC 4 → ~600 mg
  • AUC 5 → ~750 mg
  • AUC 6 → ~900 mg
  • AUC 7 → ~1050 mg
These are all calculated based on a creatinine clearance capped at 125 mL/min, and this principle should be consistently applied across all dosing.)

helpdesk-ticket.description: Hello AdeaHub Team, This is a follow-up request regarding the Additional Physician Notes functionality, which has been pending since 22 Jan in smart sheet with test number 250 As previously discussed, Dr. Elbanna had taken ownership of this task. We kindly request that this note type be made live in production as soon as possible, as it is urgently needed to support the physicians’ workflow. The detailed requirements for this request are listed below. Please also refer to the attached screenshots and the attached sheet/document containing the note specifications. We would highly appreciate your prompt action on this request, as it is becoming increasingly urgent. Thank you for your continued support. A) Physician note: Which is a special progress note template or blank template to document the patient treatment progress (history, examination, assessment, dose modifications, medical events during the round). Very similar to inpatient daily notes but this one will be for a day care service. It can be titled as: (Physician progress notes), (Chemo-immunotherapy progress note), (Day care note), (Treatment day note). Selecting or suggesting the title will be suggested and decided by Dr. Pedro B) General note: It is a blank note which should be in the system for special situations, instructions and acute events The title MUST be manually changed by the physician to rename it according to the aim of writing the document. For example if I want to make a medical report to refer the patient to a hospital I should be able to rename the (General Note) to (Medical report) Other renaming examples like (Acute event), (Communication order), (Instructions to nurses), (To whom it may concern)..etc In addition: Previously suggested templates MUST include automatic electronic signature with date and time to provide accuracy and medico-legal patient and physician protection, and to be printed in the real time to the patient if needed for other purposes. Previously suggested notes MUST include the Adding Addendum option to add new events, modifications, correcting input errors and further instructions and medical plans. C) MDT (tumor board) template must be added.)
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Urgent Follow-Up: Additional Physician Notes Request Pending Since 22 Jan request in smart sheet (test 250)
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hello AdeaHub Team,
This is a follow-up request regarding the Additional Physician Notes functionality, which has been pending since 22 Jan in smart sheet with test number 250
As previously discussed, Dr. Elbanna had taken ownership of this task. We kindly request that this note type be made live in production as soon as possible, as it is urgently needed to support the physicians’ workflow.
The detailed requirements for this request are listed below. Please also refer to the attached screenshots and the attached sheet/document containing the note specifications.
We would highly appreciate your prompt action on this request, as it is becoming increasingly urgent.
Thank you for your continued support.
A) Physician note:
  • Which is a special progress note template or blank template to document the patient treatment progress (history, examination, assessment, dose modifications, medical events during the round). Very similar to inpatient daily notes but this one will be for a day care service.
  • It can be titled as: (Physician progress notes), (Chemo-immunotherapy progress note), (Day care note), (Treatment day note). Selecting or suggesting the title will be suggested and decided by Dr. Pedro

B) General note:
  • It is a blank note which should be in the system for special situations, instructions and acute events
  • The title MUST be manually changed by the physician to rename it according to the aim of writing the document. For example if I want to make a medical report to refer the patient to a hospital I should be able to rename the (General Note) to (Medical report)
  • Other renaming examples like (Acute event), (Communication order), (Instructions to nurses), (To whom it may concern)..etc

In addition:
  • Previously suggested templates MUST include automatic electronic signature with date and time to provide accuracy and medico-legal patient and physician protection, and to be printed in the real time to the patient if needed for other purposes.
  • Previously suggested notes MUST include the Adding Addendum option to add new events, modifications, correcting input errors and further instructions and medical plans.

C) MDT (tumor board) template must be added.)

helpdesk-note.body: Dear AdeaHub Team, I have an idea to improve the visibility of patients for the phlebotomy staff. The objective is to make all patients who have laboratory orders entered visible in a dedicated patient list / worklist, covering both the clinic and infusion areas. My proposed idea is to build a tag or status indicator that can be applied by the nursing staff to identify whether the patient is currently in the clinic or infusion area. This would allow the laboratory / phlebotomy team to easily view all patients with active lab orders and track their location for sample collection. If this request is feasible, I would like to understand how this tag can be built and configured within the system. Kindly advise on the possible approach.
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Dear AdeaHub Team,
I have an idea to improve the visibility of patients for the phlebotomy staff.
The objective is to make all patients who have laboratory orders entered visible in a dedicated patient list / worklist, covering both the clinic and infusion areas.
My proposed idea is to build a tag or status indicator that can be applied by the nursing staff to identify whether the patient is currently in the clinic or infusion area. This would allow the laboratory / phlebotomy team to easily view all patients with active lab orders and track their location for sample collection.
If this request is feasible, I would like to understand how this tag can be built and configured within the system.
Kindly advise on the possible approach.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Roslina, We observed that during the medication ordering on 1/2/2026, a partial dispensing process was performed, and the service discount amount was not applied. Subsequently, on 4/3/2026, the same medication order proceeded with complete dispensing, and the discount amount was applied (please refer to the screenshots below). Hence, we would appreciate your confirmation on the following: Were there any activities or changes on 1/2/2026, or within this period, in the Billing module that could have affected the discount applicability for this charges? Have there been any other reported cases involving similar issues? Regards, AdeaHub Support
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Roslina,

We observed that during the medication ordering on 1/2/2026, a partial dispensing process was performed, and the service discount amount was not applied. Subsequently, on 4/3/2026, the same medication order proceeded with complete dispensing, and the discount amount was applied (please refer to the screenshots below).

Hence, we would appreciate your confirmation on the following:
  1. Were there any activities or changes on 1/2/2026, or within this period, in the Billing module that could have affected the discount applicability for this charges?
  2. Have there been any other reported cases involving similar issues?




Regards,
AdeaHub Support

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Related to test proof provided for MST0086647 / CUST0865977. The issue #2 raised in the test proof which is not address and SGH comments the current behavior is not correct. SGH UAT Issue #38 - The script number is updated to the merged script number in prescription tab after delete. SGH listed 6 scenarios and expected results as below:
Script No shown under ‘Script’
Current behaviour
Expected behaviours: Update to the script no that the item was last partial dispensed into If item has not been dispensed before, update to Original Script No
Scenario 1: Item has not been dispensed before
Same as Original Script No
Same as Original Script No
Scenario 2: Continue from Scenario 1, Perform 1st partial dispense
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Scenario 3: Continue from Scenario 2 (after 1st partial dispense performed), Delete item from 1st partial dispense (return to Prescription tab) Item returns to not been dispensed before
Update to same as Original Script No
Update to same as Original Script No
Scenario 4: Continue from Scenario 2 (after 1st partial dispense performed), Perform 2nd partial dispense
Update to the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Update to the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Scenario 5: Continue from Scenario 4 (after 1st and 2nd partial dispense performed), Delete item from 2nd partial dispense (return to Prescription tab) Item has been dispensed before (1st partial dispense)
Remain as the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into (May have been voided under the visit that item was dispensed into)
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Scenario 6: Continue from Scenario 4 (after 1st and 2nd partial dispense performed), Delete item from 1st partial dispense (return to Prescription tab) Item has been dispensed before (2nd partial dispense)
(Did not test)
Remain as the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Jade 23 Oct 2025: Will raise an issue log for it. We understand that the expected behaviour is to record the last script number used for dispensing in the prescription tab when there are remaining balances, based on the defined scenarios. If item has not been dispensed before, update to Original Script No. A development analysis will be required to assess the feasibility of this request Irvin 28/10/2025: May I clarify if the behaviours described are existing in current Production v369? Otherwise, noted to raise issue log (and development analysis to assess feasibility of fix to achieve the expected behaviour). Will add addressing this issue as condition for sign-off. Jade 29 Oct 2025:- The fix is to allow dispensed to visit that is not closed. The script does not update to original script number is an existing behavior in v369.

helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Related to test proof provided for MST0086647 / CUST0865977.  The issue #2 raised in the test proof which is not address and SGH comments the current behavior is not correct.
SGH UAT Issue #38 - The script number is updated to the merged script number in prescription tab after delete.
SGH listed 6 scenarios and expected results as below:
 
 
Script No shown under ‘Script’
Current behaviour
Expected behaviours:
Update to the script no that the item was last partial dispensed into
If item has not been dispensed before, update to Original Script No
Scenario 1:
Item has not been dispensed before
Same as Original Script No
Same as Original Script No
Scenario 2:
Continue from Scenario 1,
Perform 1st partial dispense
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Scenario 3:
Continue from Scenario 2 (after 1st partial dispense performed),
Delete item from 1st partial dispense (return to Prescription tab)
Item returns to not been dispensed before
Update to same as Original Script No
Update to same as Original Script No
Scenario 4:
Continue from Scenario 2 (after 1st partial dispense performed),
Perform 2nd partial dispense
Update to the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Update to the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Scenario 5:
Continue from Scenario 4 (after 1st and 2nd partial dispense performed),
Delete item from 2nd partial dispense (return to Prescription tab)
Item has been dispensed before (1st partial dispense)
Remain as the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into (May have been voided under the visit that item was dispensed into)
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Scenario 6:
Continue from Scenario 4 (after 1st and 2nd partial dispense performed),
Delete item from 1st partial dispense (return to Prescription tab)
Item has been dispensed before (2nd partial dispense)
(Did not test)
Remain as the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Jade 23 Oct 2025:   Will raise an issue log for it.  We understand that the expected behaviour is to record the last script number used for dispensing in the prescription tab when there are remaining balances, based on the defined scenarios. If item has not been dispensed before, update to Original Script No.   A development analysis will be required to assess the feasibility of this request
Irvin 28/10/2025: May I clarify if the behaviours described are existing in current Production v369?
Otherwise, noted to raise issue log (and development analysis to assess feasibility of fix to achieve the expected behaviour). Will add addressing this issue as condition for sign-off.
Jade 29 Oct 2025:-  The fix is to allow dispensed to visit that is not closed.  The script does not update to original script number is an existing behavior in v369.

helpdesk-ticket.description: Hi Adeahub support team, SGH reported issue: Maxcare sends RDE message to Fastrak that contains duplicate cancellation of transaction. Details of the transaction from user: For information only, previous RDE message (message ID 0010000J7C2R) sent to Fastrak at 27/03/2026 19:01, for newly typed items including 0000-14-29X-2 Co-amoxiclav 1g (875/125) Tab), Observation no. 0010003FFLF5, Step no. 0 Then user performs amendment at Maxcare (because patient requests to collect all medications). RDE message (message ID 0010000J7HBE) sent to Fastrak at 28/03/2026 16:24, containing duplicate cancellation for 0000-14-29X-2 Co-amoxiclav 1g (875/125) Tab), Observation no. 0010003FFLF5, Step no. 0 Message fails to process at Fastrak (this is expected behaviour at Fastrak), resulting in newly typed items in the message not sent to Fastrak for picking. Please see attached for the message with issue (message ID 0010000J7HBE). Kindly assist to investigate.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: (SGH Maxcare Production Issue) Duplicate cancellation of transaction in RDE message to Fastrak
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hi Adeahub support team,
 
SGH reported issue:  Maxcare sends RDE message to Fastrak that contains duplicate cancellation of transaction.
 
Details of the transaction from user:
For information only, previous RDE message (message ID 0010000J7C2R) sent to Fastrak at 27/03/2026 19:01, for newly typed items including 0000-14-29X-2 Co-amoxiclav 1g (875/125) Tab), Observation no. 0010003FFLF5, Step no. 0
Then user performs amendment at Maxcare (because patient requests to collect all medications).
RDE message (message ID 0010000J7HBE) sent to Fastrak at 28/03/2026 16:24, containing duplicate cancellation for 0000-14-29X-2 Co-amoxiclav 1g (875/125) Tab), Observation no. 0010003FFLF5, Step no. 0
Message fails to process at Fastrak (this is expected behaviour at Fastrak), resulting in newly typed items in the message not sent to Fastrak for picking.
 
Please see attached for the message with issue (message ID 0010000J7HBE).
 
Kindly assist to investigate.

helpdesk-ticket.description: Hello AdeaHub Team, I would like to raise a recurring issue that has been affecting my workflow in the EMR environment (PROD)** the AUT is working fine, The issue occurs particularly when switching between responsibilities / user roles. It will appear the page not responding as below screen shot. Previously, your team resolved this temporarily by providing the IP address (Enterprise Management CSC) configuration, and it had been working well for the past 2–3 weeks. However, I am facing the same issue again today, even while using the provided IP address. This is making the workflow very difficult, as every time I switch responsibilities, I am required to completely close the EMR application and log in again from the beginning. Kindly investigate this issue as a priority, as it is significantly impacting testing and operational activities. Thank you for your continued support.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Recurring EMR Access Issue in PROD
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hello AdeaHub Team,
I would like to raise a recurring issue that has been affecting my workflow in the EMR environment (PROD)** the AUT is working fine,
The issue occurs particularly when switching between responsibilities / user roles. It will appear the page not responding as below screen shot. Previously, your team resolved this temporarily by providing the IP address (Enterprise Management CSC) configuration, and it had been working well for the past 2–3 weeks.
However, I am facing the same issue again today, even while using the provided IP address.
This is making the workflow very difficult, as every time I switch responsibilities, I am required to completely close the EMR application and log in again from the beginning.
Kindly investigate this issue as a priority, as it is significantly impacting testing and operational activities.
Thank you for your continued support.

A patient is unable to proceed with the self check-in feature because the system indicates that there is an outstanding bill from a past visit. However, the patient belongs to the senior citizen (free category), and charges should not apply.

Kindly assist to further investigate and troubleshoot this issue from your side, as it is affecting the patient’s ability to use the self check-in feature.
Thank you for your support.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Muhamad Muzakir Tajul Arus, Upon reviewing the reported case, the issue did not occur today but actually took place a few days earlier. At present, there is no issue observed. To clarify, please refer to the last two records: The patient initially had a follow-up with Rehab (CS3_RFUP) under billing group RI. Subsequently, the patient had an appointment on 31/03/2026 with the INR Clinic (CS3_FU) under billing group OK. Based on the patient’s email, they were able to view a subsequent appointment on 14/04/2026 for the INR Clinic with a visit charge of RM 5. Kindly note that this occurred because the patient took the screenshot prior to the registration on 31/03/2026, when the billing group was still RI. At that point, the system mapped RI against CS3_FU, resulting in a charge of RM 5. After the registration was completed by HASIL with billing group OK for CS3_FU, the application would have refreshed accordingly. As a result, the updated mapping (OK against CS3_FU) should now reflect a visit charge of RM 0. Regards, AdeaHub Support
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Muhamad Muzakir Tajul Arus,

Upon reviewing the reported case, the issue did not occur today but actually took place a few days earlier. At present, there is no issue observed. 

To clarify, please refer to the last two records:
  • The patient initially had a follow-up with Rehab (CS3_RFUP) under billing group RI.
  • Subsequently, the patient had an appointment on 31/03/2026 with the INR Clinic (CS3_FU) under billing group OK.
 
Based on the patient’s email, they were able to view a subsequent appointment on 14/04/2026 for the INR Clinic with a visit charge of RM 5.

Kindly note that this occurred because the patient took the screenshot prior to the registration on 31/03/2026, when the billing group was still RI. At that point, the system mapped RI against CS3_FU, resulting in a charge of RM 5.

After the registration was completed by HASIL with billing group OK for CS3_FU, the application would have refreshed accordingly. As a result, the updated mapping (OK against CS3_FU) should now reflect a visit charge of RM 0.

Regards,
AdeaHub Support

helpdesk-ticket.description: Hello AdeaHub Team, We would like to raise an enhancement request regarding the current display of laboratory results and vital signs. At present, these data elements are mainly viewed through the report format, which is not the most efficient for clinical review and trend analysis. We kindly request a better flow sheet view / tabular trend view for both labs and vital signs. This enhancement would provide significant clinical and operational benefits, including: Allowing users to review results over a specific time period Enabling filtering and review by specific date ranges Supporting easier trend analysis and comparison of results Displaying the normal/reference range clearly alongside each result Showing detailed result metadata, such as: who generated / documented the result which device the result was received from source system / integration details where applicable This request has been raised based on feedback from our Biomedical team, as such visibility is important for result traceability, clinical review, and audit purposes. Please refer to the attached sample flow sheet view screenshots for reference of the requested enhancement. ( review results by selected date range compare multiple results in one view display reference / normal ranges show source device and result metadata track who documented / verified the result monitor clinical trends over time) Kindly review the feasibility of implementing this enhancement and advise on the next steps.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Enhancement Request: Improved Flow Sheet View for Labs and Vital Signs
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hello AdeaHub Team,
We would like to raise an enhancement request regarding the current display of laboratory results and vital signs.
At present, these data elements are mainly viewed through the report format, which is not the most efficient for clinical review and trend analysis. We kindly request a better flow sheet view / tabular trend view for both labs and vital signs.
This enhancement would provide significant clinical and operational benefits, including:
  • Allowing users to review results over a specific time period
  • Enabling filtering and review by specific date ranges
  • Supporting easier trend analysis and comparison of results
  • Displaying the normal/reference range clearly alongside each result
  • Showing detailed result metadata, such as:
    • who generated / documented the result
    • which device the result was received from
    • source system / integration details where applicable
This request has been raised based on feedback from our Biomedical team, as such visibility is important for result traceability, clinical review, and audit purposes.
Please refer to the attached sample flow sheet view screenshots for reference of the requested enhancement.
(
  • review results by selected date range
  • compare multiple results in one view
  • display reference / normal ranges
  • show source device and result metadata
  • track who documented / verified the result
  • monitor clinical trends over time)
Kindly review the feasibility of implementing this enhancement and advise on the next steps.

helpdesk-ticket.description: Hello AdeaHub Team, We would like to raise an issue regarding the Pharmacist task list view. From the pharmacist user perspective, within the Task List, users are able to see tasks under “Prescription Assessment Request.” However, upon opening the task, it is displaying radiology orders and laboratory orders, which should not appear within the pharmacist workflow. Kindly refer to the attached screenshot for reference. This is causing confusion in the pharmacy workflow, as the pharmacist should ideally only be able to view tasks and orders that are relevant to medication / prescription assessment activities. We kindly request your support to: investigate the root cause of why radiology and lab orders are appearing in this task apply the appropriate fix so that only pharmacy-related orders are shown advise us on the technical correction / configuration logic used to resolve this issue, for future reference and workflow understanding It would also be beneficial if you could share how this issue will be fixed from the system configuration perspective. Your prompt support in resolving this issue would be highly appreciated.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Issue in Pharmacist Task List – Prescription Assessment Request Showing Non-Pharmacy Orders
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hello AdeaHub Team,
We would like to raise an issue regarding the Pharmacist task list view.
From the pharmacist user perspective, within the Task List, users are able to see tasks under “Prescription Assessment Request.” However, upon opening the task, it is displaying radiology orders and laboratory orders, which should not appear within the pharmacist workflow.
Kindly refer to the attached screenshot for reference.
This is causing confusion in the pharmacy workflow, as the pharmacist should ideally only be able to view tasks and orders that are relevant to medication / prescription assessment activities.
We kindly request your support to:
  • investigate the root cause of why radiology and lab orders are appearing in this task
  • apply the appropriate fix so that only pharmacy-related orders are shown
  • advise us on the technical correction / configuration logic used to resolve this issue, for future reference and workflow understanding
It would also be beneficial if you could share how this issue will be fixed from the system configuration perspective.
Your prompt support in resolving this issue would be highly appreciated.

helpdesk-ticket.description: Hello AdeaHub, I would like to report an urgent issue related to the clinical documentation templates. After making modifications to the Nursing Event Note form, the template has disappeared from the front-end documentation menu. I have already attempted the standard troubleshooting steps, including rebuilding the template and refreshing the picklist configuration, however the issue still persists. In addition, I have built a new template titled “Infusion Progress Note”, and it is experiencing the same issue, as it is also not appearing on the front end. This issue is currently impacting the clinical workflow and documentation process, therefore we kindly request your urgent support to investigate and resolve it as soon as possible. Please refer to the attached screenshot for further details. Thank you for your swift support.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Urgent: Nursing Event Note and Infusion Progress Note Not Appearing on Front End After Template Modification
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hello AdeaHub,
I would like to report an urgent issue related to the clinical documentation templates.
After making modifications to the Nursing Event Note form, the template has disappeared from the front-end documentation menu. I have already attempted the standard troubleshooting steps, including rebuilding the template and refreshing the picklist configuration, however the issue still persists.
In addition, I have built a new template titled “Infusion Progress Note”, and it is experiencing the same issue, as it is also not appearing on the front end.
This issue is currently impacting the clinical workflow and documentation process, therefore we kindly request your urgent support to investigate and resolve it as soon as possible.
Please refer to the attached screenshot for further details.
Thank you for your swift support.
